ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to ensure Complaint Points, Investigation Notes and Escalated Call Number fields are populated before its being closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Complaints',
OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Upheld'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Not Upheld'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Redirected') ),
OR(
ISBLANK( Complaint_Points__c ), ISBLANK( Escalated_call_number_s__c ), ISBLANK( Investigation__c ) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Make sure Complaint Points, Escalated Call Number and Investigation Notes fields are completed
